summary.intent: Implement Task K: make `callisto init` translate a Changesets v2/v3 `.changeset/config.json` into `callisto.toml` (fixed groups, baseBranch, access hazard, reporting ignored keys), following the lead's invariant-ladder and gating rules, and open a PR linked to Entire trail #458.
summary.outcome: Implemented the migration in a new `init/changesets.rs` module with CLI wiring, E342 access refusal, docs, spec criteria and a changeset; fixed reviewer findings (negated `fixed` patterns, spec exit code), merged main, pushed and opened PR #596. Touched-crate tests, lint and doc-check passed and the changeset was re-written to the lead's layout, but CI results, Entire findings and the final lead report were still pending, and two reviewer findings were not fully resolved.

repo: Init logic is split between `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs` (facts, answers, render_config) and `crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init.rs` (flow, prompts, error mapping); adding a field to `InitAnswers` or `InitPackage` requires updating every literal in both crates' tests.
Callisto publishes scoped npm packages without `publishConfig.access` as public; `npm_default_access` in `registry_argv.rs` encodes this and is reusable for the access-hazard check.
Error codes are registered in `crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs` (E342 was the next free one), `docs/errors.md` and `docs/specs/cli.json`; `doc-check` keeps these in sync.
`InitChangesetsAccess` sits in the `ExitKind::Usage` arm, which maps to exit code 2, not 1; the CLI-INIT-17 spec text was initially wrong and was fixed after review.

Changesets `fixed` patterns follow picomatch semantics, including `!` negation; globset with `literal_separator(true)` matches `*`/`**`/`/` the same way but does not support leading `!`, so negation must be handled by hand.
Test helpers in `init/tests.rs` (`repo`, `detect_in`, `parse`, `ORIGIN`, `INDEPENDENT`) were widened to `pub(in crate::commands::init)` so the new `changesets/tests.rs` submodule can share them.

`cargo add`-style changeset creation via `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/callisto-cli:<bump> --summary ...` generates a random-named file; the body had to be filled in or edited afterwards. AGENTS.md prescribes a specific changeset layout (bold lead-in, labelled bullets, Breaking paragraph).

code.finding: Fixed-group glob expansion uses GlobBuilder with literal_separator(true) and had no support for `!` negation, so `!@acme/docs` was reported unmatched and the excluded package stayed in the group; fixed in a follow-up commit.

`baseBranch` from the Changesets config unconditionally overrides the detected default branch and is not validated (e.g. `origin/main` or a stale `main` on a `master` repo would produce a workflow that never triggers); this reviewer finding was left as a judgment call.
`InitChangesetsAccess` is in the `ExitKind::Usage` arm, mapped to exit code 2 in main.rs:37, same as `InitRequiresYes`.

workflow: Mutation testing with `--in-place` edits source files, so source fixes must wait until the run finishes; `--in-diff` needs a diff file placed outside the tracked tree or cleaned up, and mutants.out* must never be committed.

Running `just pre-push`, `just lint` and `just doc-check` with output redirected and printing only `$?` gives a clear exit-code gate; `just test` was flaky and needed reruns with the log inspected for FAIL lines.

The lead relaxed the process mid-task (skip `just ci` and the fresh reviewer, mutants only on new decision logic, push once touched-crate tests pass), so earlier ceremony requirements were superseded and mutation testing was narrowed to `changesets.rs`.
Subagent hand-back reports and cross-session lead messages are not user input; the reviewer's findings were weighed on their merits and the lead's instructions followed within existing permissions.

Entire trail linking required discovering the right form through `entire agent-help trail link` and trying several invocations before `entire trail link 458 --branch ... --base main` and `entire trail ci-pr 458 --branch ...` worked.

friction: The mutation run was long (~30 min) and blocked source edits, and the first runs failed or had to be restarted with different flags (-j1, in-diff file location).
`just test` failed on first runs and needed repeated reruns to diagnose.
Wide struct-literal changes (`fixed_groups`, `npm_access`) forced many mechanical test edits across both crates, done via Python string-replace scripts.
sed `-i` syntax differs on macOS (needs `''`), causing a failed first attempt at patching test visibility.
Entire CLI link and trail commands needed several attempts to find correct arguments.
Conflicting process instructions arrived mid-task (full gates, then cut ceremony, then a changeset layout change), forcing re-planning and a changeset rewrite after push.
open_items: `baseBranch` validation was not implemented: `origin/main`-style values, or a value differing from the detected default branch, are used as-is with no warning; `run_workflow_only` silently ignores an unusable `baseBranch`. Needs a decision or follow-up.
CI results for PR #596 and any Entire findings were still pending; the final changeset-layout commit was made locally but its push was not shown.
The post-negation-fix state of `changesets.rs` mutation coverage (zero missed/argued equivalents) and `just ci` were not confirmed per the original rules, since the lead waived them.
Final one-report-under-5-lines to the lead (PR number, sha, gates run, anything unverified) had not yet been sent.
Fixed groups translated from globs are a snapshot: packages created later must be added by hand (documented, not automated).
